description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for system upgrade operations, including file installation, hook execution, device identification, partition reading, and firmware flashing.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a RAM root, creating symlinks for symbolic links and copying regular files.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Checks if source is executable and installs it along with its libraries.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts user for a yes/no answer with a default.

methods.name: _v
methods.description: Logs verbose messages if VERBOSE is set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs upgrade messages with timestamp and system logger.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads a file and optionally decompresses it based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Reads image data with dd and get_image, filtering out broken pipe errors.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Gets magic word from image for format detection.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Gets long magic value from image.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT magic from image.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT magic from image.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 magic from image.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies image format based on magic value.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks if partition magic indicates EFI.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks if partition magic indicates FAT or FAT32.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Identifies and exports boot device information based on root partition.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device name based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts little-endian 32-bit hex to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from a device and outputs partition info.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to upgrade.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by writing image to MTD partition, with cache drop and optional backup.
